description: This file defines a controller class for the 'topic' module in the OpenCart admin interface. It handles displaying the module configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: Controller handling the display and saving of the 'topic' module configuration in OpenCart admin.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the module configuration page by setting up breadcrumbs, titles, and loading the view template.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module settings via POST request, including permission check and JSON response.
